title: Smart Traffic Control
tagline: Sensor-driven intersection monitoring with live analytics

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Urban intersections in growing East African cities lack real-time traffic data. Manual counts are expensive and outdated within weeks. City planners need continuous flow metrics to justify signal timing changes.

approach.title: How I approached it
approach.body: I placed ultrasonic sensors on ESP8266 nodes to measure vehicle presence at each approach. Data streams via MQTT into a Python ingest service I wrote, then a live dashboard with peak-hour heatmaps and blocked-lane alerts.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.body: Deployed as a university capstone with production-grade documentation. Demonstrated 94% detection accuracy in controlled tests. Architecture spec adopted as reference design for municipal pilot discussions.
